# Fallout TV series starts on April 12, 2024 on Amazon Prime

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_234_nukaknights-post-fallout-tv-series.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## Fallout TV series launch announcement for April 12, 2024

## Background

The Amazon Prime TV series called "Fallout" was developed by Lisa Joy and Jonathan Nolan and is a franchise from Interplay Entertainment and the rights are owned by Bethesda Softworks.

Amazon acquired the rights to produce a live-action show in 2020 and announced it in July of the same year with the participation of Kilter Films. Shortly thereafter, Lisa Joy and Jonathan Nolan (The Dark Knight, Interstellar, Memento) became head writers and Bethesda Game Studios' Todd Howard became executive producer. The duo of Geneva Robertson-Dworet and Graham Wagner were hired as showrunners in January 2022 and Walton Goggins and Ella Purnell were cast in the lead roles.

| ![Ella Purnell](/uploads/ella-purnell-serpentine-summer-party-2017.jpg) Films: Kick-Ass 2, Wildlike, Island of Special Children Image: IMDB | ![Walton Goggins](/uploads/walton-goggins-march-19-2014-.jpg) Films: The Hateful 8, Justified, Predators Image: IMDB | 

##Story

Nothing really is known about the story yet. What we do know is that the Fallout series is set in the post-nuclear world after the Great War in **Los Angeles**. It also became known that a **Vault 33** plays a major role.

![Fallout TV Series: Vault 33 / Los Angeles](/uploads/fallout-los-angeles-vault-33-twitter.jpg) 

## Follow

According to IMDB, **8 episodes** are currently being filmed in the first season of the Fallout series. 

The first episode will be called "**The End**". Nothing more is known about this yet.
